claims.note: 4.1 heading: RIT Hub internal ledger reuses Proofpress event semantics, not its file-level carrier
What migrates is event semantics (actor/claim/evidence/why/accept-reject-open/parent + claims-vs-diff check), not the single-file portable capsule carrier
Why: RIT Hub's trust unit is the claim (graph node), not a file

Four consequences: anchor unit becomes claim not block; no same-identity revision bookkeeping needed; human approval layer stays outside RIT's kernel/extractor; portable capsule becomes an export feature, not the internal default

context.why: Founder + orchestrator session (6b0b2a60) 战略讨论产出的架构判断：RIT Hub 内部账本应迁移 Proofpress 的事件语义（actor/claim/evidence/why/accept-reject-open/parent + claims-vs-diff 检查），而不是它现在单文件 portable capsule 的载体实现；记录为新增小节 4.1，插入第4节与第5节之间。
